decision: No standalone quote supported by these two public notices.

notices.scope: cloud-based electronic wayfinding and pathfinding solution
notices.finding: Public overview describes a deployed navigation solution and supplies no separate offline QA lot.

notices.scope: development of technical, commercial and environmental resources
notices.finding: GETS splits price and non-price response files. The public overview provides no separately selectable spreadsheet or documentation lot and asks for domain-specific research.

coverage: Public notice text only. Tender packs and supplier-only terms were not reviewed.
reopen: A readable original document expressly inviting a standalone offline deliverable with measurable acceptance criteria and time to respond.
